goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Audit complete: SuperMemory is a healthy contract-ready CLI/governance foundation, not yet the local web product. The vault, snapshots, recoverable registries, governed Hindsight transport and 34 tests are real. Missing runtime stages are the web UI/API, PDF/DOCX extraction, arbitrary-document semantic compilation, interactive review, cited end-user search, folder reconciliation, deletion UX and restart proof. The first recommended vertical slice is a persistent local web workflow for Markdown/TXT from folder selection through review and cited search.
facts: npm test passes 34 of 34 existing tests.
The release gate passes at contract-ready and explicitly reports runtime_ready=false and production_ready=false.
The latest live evidence is stale at 97.81 hours against a 24-hour maximum, and runtime env is absent.
The pinned Hindsight container is currently running on localhost ports 8888 and 9999.
No web application, server, frontend dependency, PDF parser, DOCX parser, OCR adapter or chunker exists.
Onboarding reads selected files as UTF-8, records snapshots and emits no promotion payloads.
Hindsight promotion consumes already-structured governed input; it does not compile arbitrary documents.
contradictions: The architectural lifecycle includes compiled memory and review, but the onboarding runtime deliberately stops after snapshot registration.
Existing production approval evidence applies to the operator deployment, not the new local web product oracle.
Green fixture contracts do not prove arbitrary folder documents are semantically processed.
ambiguity_requiring_judge: Minimal local web stack and folder-selection boundary.
Deterministic versus optional LLM candidate generation in the first vertical slice.
Whether Hindsight is mandatory for the first product milestone or may degrade to deterministic local search.
